titleEn: Break It in Half, Enjoy It Together!

pages.text: "This rice cake is mine! I'm eating it all!" At the work-break spot on the bank, Dingding held the last rice cake tightly in both hands. Soft and chewy, it was Dingding's favorite. Mom stood rice bundles upright nearby.

Mr. Ming, who kept ducks in the lowest paddy, came up the bank. "I'm here to help carry the bundles." Mom said, "Let's give him some rice cake." Dingding hugged it close and turned away. "No! It's mine!"
Mr. Ming chuckled and sat on a flat stone a little way off. Dingding took a bite alone. But somehow it did not taste good. "That's strange... Why doesn't it taste good?"

Mom sat beside Dingding. "Why the pout over your favorite rice cake?" Dingding looked at the half-eaten cake. "It's sweet, but chewing it feels lonely." Farther away, Mr. Ming had no food, only water to drink.

Mom tapped the cake in Dingding's hand. "Break it in half, and there'll be two tastes and two smiles." "Really? If I split it?" Dingding looked down. The thick cake was just right for dividing in half.
Dingding held it in both hands and broke it in half. Two equal pieces rested side by side on their palms. Dingding hurried toward the flat stone.

"I'm sorry about earlier. Let's eat this together!" Dingding offered one half. Mr. Ming's eyes widened as he accepted it. "Thank you." Dingding said in a singsong voice, "Break It in Half, Enjoy It Together!"
They sat together on the stone and ate. It tasted much better than before! Dingding sniffed and giggled at the duck smell on Mr. Ming's vest. Mom smiled beside them.
At the next work-break meal, Dingding split a rice cake first and offered half to Mom. "One, ask first! Two, break it in half! Three, enjoy it together!" "Mom, let's share!"
Mom hugged Dingding. "You know how to offer half now!" Sharing halves made two tastes and two smiles. Dingding waved their half of the cake. "Break It in Half, Enjoy It Together!"
